entries.name: Rafael Cancel Miranda

expected.charges: Assault with intent to kill (5 counts).
expected.sentence:
75 years (assault) + 6 years (sedition) = 81 years

Charges as recorded: Assault with intent to kill (5 counts) for the March 1, 1954 armed attack on the U.S. House of Representatives, in which four Puerto Rican Nationalists fired ~30 rounds from the Ladies' Gallery, wounding five congressmen. Additional 6-year sentence under Smith Act for seditious conspiracy (October 1954). Defendants refused parole conditions requiring renunciation of Puerto Rican independence. Sentences commuted by President Carter in 1977-1979.

entries.rationale: Official House history identifies March1,1954 Capitol shooting and arrests same day; contemporary1979 report individually identifies Rafael among four physically released Sept10,1979. Existing dates Feb28/Sept9 are one day early.
